values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/biglakeupper ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Small concrete ramp for small boats, canoes and kayaks; carry-in access in the campground. ORVs and snowmobiles may run between the campground and nearby trails (Baraga Plains ORV Trail 1.5 miles west).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/biglakeupper ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'There's a small concrete ramp suitable for small boats, canoes and kayaks', 'The operation of an ORV and snowmobile between the campground and nearby trails is allowed'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/biglakeupper ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 15 'tent and small trailer sites' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/biglakeupper ('this rustic campground offers 15 tent and small trailer sites', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (15 campsites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The DNR gives the seasonal closure as 'weather dependent'; no dates.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Big Lake State Forest Campground, Baraga Co.: 'Seasonal closure dates' 'weather dependent'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the east shore of 127-acre Big Lake, 9.2 miles north of Covington via M-28 West, West Plains Road and Big Lake Road. Direct access to the Baraga Plains ORV Trail; fall waterfowl hunting in the Baraga Plains State Waterfowl Management Area; perch, crappie and bass fishing. --Claude
